findings.title: Authored semantic equality is dropped by source adapter
findings.evidence: grouped-record-candidates-v6b has no semantics.oracle on any of23rows; checkOracle defaults exact. Reversing astra-ecology-01.increase or astra-archives-02.clusters preserves the declared set meaning but returned accepted:false, level:exact in actual runtime comparator calls. sol001 correctedClaims was withdrawn as a false-negative example because its visible query explicitly requires ascending IDs.
findings.required: Emit field-specific unordered paths; preserve ordered chronology/path arrays; judge prose and alternative witnesses against source constraints. Exercise positive permutations and negative omitted/extra/wrong-ID mutations.

findings.title: Scripted reference replay bypasses named stages
findings.evidence: reference() reads files through scoped literal then synthesizer child returns authored expected; no named helper chain is invoked. Passing replay verifies plumbing/typing/readability and oracle transport, not independent oracle truth or semantic topology.
findings.required: Retain independent source-oracle review receipts and live active-parent/stage-contribution checks.

findings.title: Sol authored typed witness/frontier structures weakened
findings.evidence: runtimeTypeFile replaces RelationDecision proposition/relatedIds/witnesses{path,quote} with status:string/evidenceIds/detail, WorkItem candidateIds/requiredProposition with kind, and domain bundle fields with unknown.
findings.required: Preserve useful typed structures or explicitly justify translated contract and measure it; retain exact quote/path witness checks.
findings.resolution: 115fc18c preserves all7 authored aliases. Independently checked all100 Sol types.ts and fixture maps in full-type-fidelity-candidates-v1; report23/23 reference replay, source SHA8a45513f3c9b68feeb072aa114e17abf32e4e677144c22ce301d86df17788d11.

findings.title: Astra individual-record literal ID alias is implicit
findings.evidence: Authored local argument is {id,text}; emitted helper item is EvidenceRecord{path,text}. More seriously, archives01 expected unassigned r21 is from source_fixture.records[].id, but emitted files/typed records expose only record-21.txt path and text; no visible r21 alias map exists.
findings.required: Render explicit authored record IDs and ID/path mapping into model-visible source. Accept only declared aliases; do not infer hidden ID conventions. Rebuild/replay/sample as source repair, not model-negative evidence.

findings.title: Deep forwarding calls do not establish meaningful stage contributions
findings.evidence: Partial grouped v6b /8 buildVoyages forwards unchanged stageFindings; /9 resolveTemporalClaims creates an unused Neuralese literal and forwards unchanged. inventoryLetters and interpretDatePhrase do show meaningful record-local NL chronology interpretation.
findings.required: Inspect sealed trace for distinct named-stage decisions or classify forwarding as plumbing. Do not count unused literals as semantic work.

findings.title: Grouped per-record coverage not yet sealed
findings.evidence: Static types require one finding per record but arrays do not enforce bijection or real IDs. Partial trace preserves record02/03/05/06 paths and correct local relations; results.jsonl was empty at inspection.
findings.required: For each batch enforce exact sourcePath bijection, evidence ID resolution, and grounded unresolved claims; inspect whole24-record result and active call parents.

findings.title: Record count overstates connected per-task semantic depth
findings.evidence: Astra120 share one5-stage scaffold;54worlds comprise40single-case worlds,10worlds reused6ways,4worlds reused5ways. Several24-record shared-world queries need only a few decisive records, while archaeology03/05 and folklore04 are strongly repetitive.
findings.required: Record task-specific relevant evidence, interdependent joins and dependent decision layers. Keep valid simpler cases in the mix; hold only concrete bugs. Add new application-scale programs separately.

findings.title: Gold-inferred nested map keys reveal answer categories
findings.evidence: archives04.series root type enumerates inferred creator/function labels; ecology06.contradictions root type enumerates H2/H3/H4, revealing the contradicted hypothesis set. folklore05.beliefs and conservation01.plans also use closed object-key rosters inferred from gold though these rosters are already input-defined.
findings.required: Use source-authored generic Record maps or justified publicly specified schemas; inspect all120 root types and rerender/replay before pilot.
findings.resolution: All120 root types inspected; four dynamic maps replaced with generic Record maps in catalog. Fixture/gold unchanged; affected cases held for presentation repair.
